tagline: Cusco's main airport. The gateway to Machu Picchu and the Sacred Valley.
description: The primary airport serving Cusco. Note that there are NO direct shared taxis to the Sacred Valley from the airport. You must take a private taxi directly to your hotel, or take a short taxi to Terminal Pavitos or Terminal Puputi to catch a shared taxi.

name: Pacha Munay Wellness Resort
tagline: Rediscover your inner peace where the mountains meet the soul.
description: Tucked away in the heart of Urubamba, Pacha Munay is a sanctuary for profound rejuvenation, blending ancient Andean wisdom with boutique luxury. Guests flock here for the signature 'Allowing Ease' program, which pairs transformative yoga and meditation with unparalleled 1:1 support in a setting of sublime natural beauty. After a day of spiritual exploration or a guided detox, retreat to your rustic-chic casita, where earthy textures and stunning mountain vistas create an atmosphere of unparalleled tranquility and deep rest.

name: Nidra Wasi
tagline: Your spiritual sanctuary in the heart of the Sacred Valley.
description: Nestled at the base of the sacred Apu Intihuatana, this holistic hub is the heartbeat of Pisac's conscious community. Built with earthy, sustainable materials, the space exudes a grounding yet vibrant energy, inviting guests to connect with themselves and the potent land. More than a B&B, Nidra Wasi serves as a vital gathering place, offering world-class yoga, diverse healing arts, and community events that draw in both global travelers and local wisdom keepers for an authentic, transformative experience.

name: Sach'a Munay
tagline: Experience Andean eco-luxury where sacred mountains and cascading waterfalls meet.
description: Tucked away in the serene village of Arin, Sach'a Munay offers a sublime escape where the energy of a sacred waterfall and towering Apus converge. Harmonizing rustic elegance with sustainable principles, the sanctuary boasts a breathtaking glass-walled yoga shala for sunrise practices and authentic Andean Chullpas for deep meditation. Guests can rejuvenate in the extensive wellness facilities before savoring organic, garden-to-table meals cultivated on-site, fully immersing themselves in the center's profound commitment to Pachamama and personal healing.
